name: GRAMMER AG
summary: GRAMMER Aktiengesellschaft’s Americas segment posted an operating EBIT loss of EUR 6.2 million in H1 2026 due to higher logistics and tariff costs [1]. Operating EBIT jumped to EUR 75.1 million in FY 2025 from EUR 41.6 million in FY 2024, driven by the “Top 10” restructuring programme and capacity adjustments [2] [3]. Yet the accumulated loss remained EUR –244.1 million at 31 Dec 2025, only slightly better than EUR –261.3 million a year earlier [4]. FY 2025 net income swung to EUR 17.2 million from a EUR –115.2 million loss in FY 2024, but no dividend is proposed because the 2024 loan agreement suspends payouts until 2027 [5] [6]. Scope Ratings GmbH rates the company B+/stable as of 29 Jun 2026, unchanged from the June 2025 rating and a two‑notch upgrade from BB/stable in 2022 [7] [8] [9].

This places the risk at the mixed-evidence level (50) with medium confidence.

report.headline: GRAMMER AG: Profit recovery but EUR 244m accumulated loss persists

findings.text: Operating EBIT rose sharply to EUR 75.1 million in FY 2025 from EUR 41.6 million in FY 2024, driven by a “Top 10” restructuring programme and capacity adjustments.
The company still carried an accumulated loss of EUR –244.1 million as of 31 December 2025, only slightly improved from EUR –261.3 million a year earlier.
FY 2025 net income was EUR 17.2 million, a swing from a EUR –115.2 million net loss in FY 2024.
No dividend is proposed for FY 2025 because of the accumulated loss; dividend payments are suspended under the loan agreement renewed in 2024 until 2027.
